quote.text: A certain amount of opposition is a great help to a man. Kites rise against not with the wind. Even a head wind is better than nothing.
quote.author: John Neal, “Enterprise and Perseverance,” Weekly Mirror (New York), 1846 — universally attributed to Churchill, who was born twenty-eight years after it was printed

stories.kicker: Buy It Once · rice cookers & donabe
stories.headline: The grail premium in this category buys you five degrees Celsius. The best-tested machine in the record is a third of the price
stories.dek: Pressure lifts the boil from 100°C to 105. Fifty batches at America’s Test Kitchen put the fuzzy-logic middle rung on top — and marked the expensive ones down for inconsistency.

stories.kicker: The Rabbit Hole · kite flying & kite building
stories.headline: The hour at the edge of the window
stories.dek: Four crafts share the word “kite” and almost nothing else. One of them will fly backwards, stop dead and hover upside down — and in Singapore, for seven months of the year, none of them will fly at all.

stories.headline: The race is six days away and the November sumo was gone before most people knew it was on sale
stories.dek: Every row below was re-checked against a venue, promoter or official seller. A dozen candidates failed and are named at the foot.

stories.headline: Seven governments opened their tanks on Friday. The barrel they cannot reach went up
stories.dek: One hundred million barrels over four months, diesel first and frontloaded. Brent rose; West Texas fell nearly two per cent. The eleven-dollar gap between them is the reply.

stories.kicker: Singapore · the needle and the air
stories.headline: The girls who had their first jab this year will get a different vaccine for the second. It covers ninety per cent instead of seventy
stories.dek: From January the nine-valent vaccine enters the national schedule. And the haze this desk reported as broken on Wednesday was still at ninety-five in the Central region at five this morning.

stories.headline: An executive order abolished the term “artificial intelligence” on Tuesday. It contains no money, no compute and no megawatts
stories.dek: The United States will now say “Super Intelligence.” The only deadline in the document asks a science adviser to invent a legal definition within sixty days.

stories.kicker: The Kit · the box that runs the big models
stories.headline: Seven thousand four hundred dollars buys a hundred and sixty gigabytes of video memory. The only speed figure anyone has published is the vendor’s
stories.dek: And it is sixteen tokens a second across two of them — about reading speed, for fifteen thousand dollars of hardware.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · the specification arrives
stories.headline: Three numbers this desk refused to print last issue are now settled. The price we did print was the wrong year’s
stories.dek: Forty point eight millimetres by 15.41, and 28,800 vibrations an hour. The maker’s own press release says €8,950 and gives no dollar figure at all.

stories.headline: A seven-year-old film took Japan, Singapore and the United States in the same weekend. It made more in two days in Japan than in three across America
stories.dek: And the Tom Cruise picture that opened yesterday has settled four points lower than the number this desk printed on Friday.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · the measurable thing
stories.headline: The first thing that moved was not her mood. It was how well she could stop herself
stories.dek: Nearly ten thousand children, three waves, and a lab task rather than a questionnaire. The effect is real, small, and runs through attention.

stories.headline: Payrolls missed by sixty thousand and the long end sold off anyway. That is the whole regime in one morning
stories.dek: Bad news has stopped being good news for duration, because the inflation is a cost shock. The ten-year breakeven says 2.36 per cent while actual inflation runs 3.4.

stories.headline: Four weeks of squeezing a wall took nine points off systolic. One session a week keeps most of it; none loses all of it
stories.dek: The held thread closes: the trial this desk could not read in September published on Monday, effect sizes and all.

stories.headline: The invitation goes out in five weeks. The seat flies in fifteen months
stories.dek: Singapore Airlines will show its new long-haul cabins on 7 November. Entry into service has already slipped from last year’s target to the first quarter of 2027.

stories.headline: The eight hundred thousand who were always there
stories.dek: Uzbekistan counted itself for the first time in thirty-seven years and found two per cent more people than it had. Nobody had moved. They had simply been illegal to admit to.
